{{Top|sprot}}
<onlyinclude><small>(In {{#ifeq:{{{1}}}|multiple|multiple advertisements|an advertisement}})</small></onlyinclude>

==Usage==
Use <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Advert}}</code> if the subject appears in a single advertisement or <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Advert|multiple}}</code> if the subject appears in multiple advertisements.

==Examples==
{| class="wikitable"
! Code
! Result
|-
| <pre style="background:none; border:none">[[Star Wars Insider 90|''Star Wars Insider'' 90]] {{Advert}}</pre>
| [[Star Wars Insider 90|''Star Wars Insider'' 90]] {{Advert}}
|-
| <pre style="background:none; border:none">[[Star Wars Insider 90|''Star Wars Insider'' 90]] {{Advert|multiple}}</pre>
| [[Star Wars Insider 90|''Star Wars Insider'' 90]] {{Advert|multiple}}
|}
